stemMarkdown: In a 500 m race, A beats B by 25 m. Find the ratio of A's speed to B's speed, expressed as a decimal. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: When A finishes 500 m, B has run only $500 - 25 = 475$ m in the same time. Since the times are equal, the speeds are in the ratio of the distances: $\dfrac{500}{475} = 1.0526$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equal time is the hinge — it is what lets you compare distances directly as speeds.
